message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine statutory charges under Chinese law for illegal wildlife trade. The facts: purchase of protected animal ivory (national first-level protected species) 0.33 kg, value 13,750 RMB, and purchase of a second-level protected animal (hornbill) product 19.9g. The defendant was operating a shop. Likely charges: "非法买卖国家重点保护野生动物及其制品罪" (illegal buying/selling of protected wildlife and products). Under Criminal Law Article 341? Actually Article 341 deals with illegal hunting, killing, trading of protected wildlife. The charge is "非法买卖国家重点保护野生动物及其制品罪". Also possibly "走私罪"? But not necessarily smuggling across borders. So main charge: illegal trade of protected wildlife products.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法买卖国家重点保护野生动物及其制品罪<eoa>

If multiple charges? Could also be "非法经营罪"? But likely just one.

Thus final.
